page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.8xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs, maintaining a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core. The processor includes a 48 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512, AES, and SHA_NI. This instance does not include local storage or GPUs, and it features a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.r7.8xlarge demonstrates solid mid-range performance across various workloads. Its single-core stress-ng CPU performance is measured at 1865.39, while multi-core performance reaches 30983.52. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 1689.81 GB/sec, and large block uncached read and write speeds of 141.73 GB/sec and 65.94 GB/sec respectively. The instance achieves a Geekbench multi-core score of 13384.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 35326.14. For specialized tasks, it processes Redis SET operations at 30.13 million operations per second and handles static web serving at a throughput of 28.84 GB/sec. Notably, its text generation speed for a small 135M LLM model is strong, reaching 282.15 tokens per second.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8 and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.r7.8xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. The absence of bundled local storage means storage costs are decoupled, allowing users to scale block storage independently. This hardware profile is well-suited for enterprise databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, data processing pipelines, and medium-scale language model inference tasks.
